The Senior QA Engineer - Data Testing / ETL is responsible for validating data quality, completeness, and transformations across end-to-end data pipelines and migrations into Guidewire InsuranceSuite and downstream systems. This role focuses on SQL driven backend validation, reconciliation, and non-functional checks, working closely with data engineers, migration teams, and functional QA to ensure defect-free, production-ready data.

  • Perform end-to-end ETL testing, including source-to-target data validation, reconciliation, and transformation checks across multiple stages of the pipeline.
  • Write and execute complex SQL queries for backend data validation.
  • Create detailed test plans, test scenarios, and test cases/scripts based on mapping documents, user stories, and business requirements.

  • Validate data correctness in target applications to ensure migrated/loaded data supports key business scenarios.
  • Log, track, and manage defects to closure using tools such as Jira, including clear steps, SQL evidence, and impact analysis.
  • Provide daily/regular test execution and status reports to stakeholders, highlighting progress, defect trends, and risks.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (data engineers, migration developers, functional QA, BAs, architects, and customer SMEs) to ensure data quality and timely delivery.
  • Contribute to and maintain reusable SQL libraries, reconciliation templates, and best-practice checklists for data testing across projects.

Requirements

    • Data migration to core policy/claims/billing systems, or
    • ETL/ELT and data warehousing / data lake testing.
  • Familiarity with Guidewire InsuranceSuite data models and migration tooling.
  • Proven experience designing data test strategies, authoring detailed test cases, and executing reconciliation/NFR tests across multiple dry runs.
  • Strong defect investigation skills: able to isolate issues using SQL, mapping documents, and logs, and articulate root causes and business impact.
  • Comfortable working in Agile/Scrum delivery with distributed teams (data engineers, migration developers, functional QA, architects, customer SMEs).
  • Good communication skills and ability to manage own workload, priorities, and timelines.

Nice to Have

  • Experience on Guidewire based data migration projects (InsuranceSuite cloud or on-prem) or similar core system transformations.
  • Exposure to cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Fabric/OneLake, Snowflake) and associated ETL/ELT tools.
  • Experience with analytics and BI tools such as Power BI or Fabric and with Guidewire data tooling such as Data Studio and Explore, for validating downstream datasets, reports and KPIs.

Job Summary

Overview About Business Unit: Powerful predictors of the future - our Analytics team seamlessly blends data science and business intelligence to provide unparalleled foresight for our platform offerings. They turn insights into actionable results for our clients by collaborating with senior team members and staying ahead of market trends, powered by our data assets. By using new-age analytic tools and emerging technologies, the team cultivates a dynamic learning environment for curious minds to thrive.

How Youll Make an Impact: The Manager, Account Analytics Development is a hands-on technical leader. You will personally design and build the most technically demanding parts of our AI capability, and you will hire and develop the engineer who works alongside you. This is a small, senior team - today a VP and a Lead. You will be the third member, and the first person you hire will report to you. We already run AI agents in production that generate analyst-grade SQL against our analytics environment. That foundation works. What comes next is harder, and it is the reason this role exists.

What Youll Build: Interpretation. Systems that take the output of an analysis and produce business-relevant interpretation - what the numbers mean for this client, in this category, given what we know about their objectives. This is the distance between a query result and an insight, and closing it requires reasoning, not summarization. Client knowledge. A knowledge system that accumulates and organizes what the organization understands about each client: their business, their category, their measurement history, and Epsilons relationship with them. It has to serve both people and agents, and it has to compound with use rather than decay into a stale wiki. Media investment planning. Analytical tooling that supports budget allocation and media investment planning - putting scenario and optimization capability directly in the hands of client teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture of our AI capability: how agents are scoped, how they compose, and where the boundaries sit between tools, context, and model reasoning.
  • Design evaluation before you design the solution.
  • Define how we will know an agent is correct, how we detect regression in a non-deterministic system, and where human review belongs in the loop.
  • Establish the engineering standards - source control, testing, documentation, deployment - that let a three-person team ship reliably today and a larger team ship reliably later.
  • Write production code.
  • Prototype quickly to resolve technical uncertainty, then make the explicit call about what graduates into a supported system and what gets discarded.
  • Take personal ownership of the components carrying the highest technical risk rather than delegating them.
  • Hire, onboard, and develop your first direct report at senior engineer level.
  • Set technical direction and raise the quality bar through design review and code review.
  • Absorb technical scope currently carried by the VP and become a person the wider analytics organization brings its hardest problems to.
  • Promote engineering discipline, documentation, code quality, and knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Work directly with analytics leads and client teams, most of whom are US-based, to find where automation and AI create real leverage - and where they do not.
  • Translate loosely specified business problems into system designs, and explain those designs credibly to non-technical partners.
  • Balance experimentation against the reality that these tools enter client-facing workflows and have to keep working.
  • Your work will be evaluated by the level of usage and adoption by the rest of the Analytics team and the ability of the tools you and the team develop to drive greater efficiency and insights.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years building software or data products, including leading technical design on complex, ambiguous projects.
  • Strong Python and advanced SQL.
  • You are comfortable both in a substantial codebase and in an analytical data warehouse.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and shipping LLM-based systems in production - agents, tool use, orchestration, structured outputs - not prototypes or prompt experimentation alone.
  • Systems thinking. You can take an ambiguous capability such as interpret this analysis and decompose it into components, interfaces, and failure modes, then explain why you drew the boundaries where you did.
  • A considered point of view on evaluating non-deterministic systems, and practical experience applying it.
  • Working familiarity with marketing measurement - attribution, incrementality, media mix modeling, campaign performance - sufficient to judge whether an automated interpretation is analytically sound. You will not be building measurement models; you will be building systems that reason about their output.
  • Experience mentoring or leading engineers, whether or not you have held a formal management title.
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
  • Additional Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Preferred Technical Experience

Additional Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Preferred Technical Experience

  • Agentic development environments - Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar - used as a daily working tool rather than tried once.
  • Databricks, Greenplum or PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, or comparable analytical platforms.
  • Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and disciplined code review practice.
  • Building knowledge management or retrieval systems that stay accurate as they grow.
  • Integrating applications with APIs, databases, and enterprise platforms.
  • Marketing analytics, media, or adtech background.
  • Working with data under client confidentiality and governance constraints.

How You Work

You are opinionated about design and you change your mind when the evidence says to. You are comfortable being the most senior technical person in the room and equally comfortable being wrong in it. You would rather ship something useful and imperfect than design something elegant that never lands.

title: Sr Oracle Cloud SCM Techno-Functional Architect
jobDescription:
About the role
We are hiring a hands-on Senior Oracle Cloud SCM Techno-Functional Architect, based in our Noida or Bangalore office, to sit at the intersection of our product team and our customers. You will help expand the SCM capabilities of Config Agent and Testing Agent, the automation engines our customers rely on for Oracle configuration migration and test execution, and based on need, support delivery for customers running these products on live Oracle SCM programs.
This is not a classic implementation consulting role. You will bring deep Oracle SCM functional and technical knowledge into product development: defining how our agents should handle SCM setups, FBDI conversions, extracts, APIs, and integration touchpoints, validating product behavior against real Oracle environments, and stepping into customer engagements where deep SCM expertise is needed to unblock delivery.
What you will do
  • Product capability expansion: Partner with product and engineering to design and expand Config Agent and Testing Agent capabilities across Oracle Cloud SCM, including functional setup migration via FSM, FBDI/LOADERS, and setup APIs.
  • Architecture ownership: Define the technical architecture for how Opkey agents discover, extract, transform, and load Oracle SCM configuration and transactional data, and how they validate results post-load.
  • Conversions and transformations: Bring authoritative expertise on SCM data conversion and transformation strategy: source-to-target mapping, transformation logic, load sequencing, error handling, and reconciliation.
  • SCM functional depth: Define how core Oracle SCM modules (Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, and Costing) are configured end to end, so agent automation reflects real setup dependencies, sequencing, and how Oracle actually behaves in customer environments.
  • Integrations: Advise on integration patterns across OIC, REST/SOAP web services, and ESS scheduling, and how Opkey automation should exercise and validate them.
  • RICEF architecture: Apply full RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, Forms/Workflows) build and architecture experience to shape agent coverage, test design, and configuration scope decisions.
  • Customer delivery support: Support Config Agent and Testing Agent customers during SCM implementations and quarterly Oracle releases, troubleshooting complex Oracle-side issues, validating agent behavior, and advising customer and SI partner technical teams.
  • Release advisory: Contribute to functional and technical advisory content on Oracle release cycles (26A to 26D and beyond), migration paths, and platform changes that affect customers and product roadmap.
What you bring
  • 10+ years of hands-on Oracle Cloud SCM implementation experience as a techno-functional consultant, acting in a lead or architect capacity.
  • Deep, practitioner-level expertise in FBDI/LOADERS: business object structures, load orchestration, error resolution, and large-volume conversion strategy.
  • Deep understanding of backend tables, metadata, and how to query with SQL.
  • Proven delivery of data conversions and transformations from legacy systems (EBS, PeopleSoft, SAP, Workday, or homegrown) into Oracle Cloud SCM.
  • Functional depth across core SCM modules (Inventory, Procurement, Order Management, and Costing), with proven ownership of FSM setups, organization structures, and cross-module dependencies.
  • Integration build experience across OIC, REST/SOAP APIs, FBDI, and ESS jobs.
  • Full-lifecycle RICEF build and architecture experience: you have designed, built, tested, and supported these objects in production.
  • Redwood / Visual Builder Studio familiarity and awareness of Oracles UI extensibility direction.
  • AI Agent Studio experience
  • Working knowledge of Oracle configuration frameworks: FSM, security and roles, flexfields, lookups, value sets, and profile options.
  • Ability to translate Oracle platform behavior into product requirements: you can explain to engineers why Oracle works the way it does and what automation must account for.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity: this role spans product development, technical advisory, and live customer delivery.
  • Clear written and verbal communication for executive, partner, and customer audiences.
Nice to have
  • Exposure to test automation platforms or ERP testing practices.
  • Experience with agentic AI, LLM-based tooling, or automation frameworks (Playwright, RPA).
  • Experience with Manufacturing, Supply Planning, Logistics, or Maintenance modules.
  • Big four consulting experience.
Why this role
You will shape how an entire category of Oracle SCM automation works, not for one customer but for every customer running Opkey. Your Oracle expertise becomes product capability with compounding reach, and you keep direct customer contact so your knowledge stays sharp and current with each Oracle release.
Opkey is an equal opportunity employer. To apply, contact the Opkey talent team with your CV and a summary of relevant Oracle Cloud SCM delivery experience.

Sr. UX Designer The client stands at the intersection of tech & retail in the B2B space developing innovative purchasing and procurement solutions to help businesses and organizations thrive. The Business User Experience team champions the business customer in the Marketplace and supports procurement elements for Business customers. Areas that a Senior UX Designer in team will support include partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver customer-centric solutions for admins involved in business procurement for all sizes of businesses.
You will work with the foundational services team to enhance the account management tools in the account configuration and analytics space. A Senior UX Designer in this organization works on tactical and strategic. They determine the strategy and where to simplify or extend solutions for the best outcome. They will make use of best practices and learn to influence and force multiply.
This role needs to be capable of operating autonomously in partnering with product stakeholders from the enterprise account management team to research, define requirements and realize solutions for complex problems across the end-to-end account admins experience. This role will be instrumental in defining the agentic experiences leveraging latest AI technologies.

Key job responsibilities
The Senior UX Designers role is to facilitate process where there is ambiguity in product strategy, product requirements, and technical feasibility. They will be expected to pull insights, guide product stakeholders into design exercises and activities to shape and prioritize user stories ahead of designing solutions.
This role must be able to recognize risks and effectively communicate and escalate issues that may impact the customer experience, then help to arrive at solutions that are acceptable to cross-functional stakeholders

The Business Development Manager at NextGenSoft will be responsible for driving revenue growth by managing the complete sales lifecycle for Cloud, Data, DevOps, and AI-led services. 1. Sales & Revenue Growth

  • Cloud & DevOps
  • Data Engineering

  • Application Modernization
  • Drive monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.

2. Marketing & Demand Generation

  • Drive outbound campaigns using:
  • LinkedIn

  • Coordinate with technical SMEs to prepare:

  • Commercials & pricing
  • Build long-term client relationships with CXOs, CTOs, and Product Heads.

  • Identify and build partnerships with:
  • Cloud providers
  • Product companies

  • Support co-selling and joint go-to-market initiatives.

  • Revenue forecasts
  • Provide market intelligence and competitor insights to leadership.

Must-Have

  • 7-15 years of experience in IT Services / Technology Sales.
  • Proven track record of closing B2B deals (mid-size to enterprise).

  • Exposure to Gen-AI, Data Platforms, Snowflake, or AI Agents.
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • Apollo
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Existing network in tech startups, SaaS, or enterprises.

Lead/Senior Quality Assurance

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Automation QA Engineer with expertise in AI-driven testing to join our quality engineering team. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in building automated test frameworks, integrating AI/ML tools to optimize testing workflows, and ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of complex applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for web, mobile, API, and enterprise applications.
  • Leverage AI/ML-powered tools (e.g., Testim, Mabl, Applitools, Functionize, or custom AI solutions) to enhance test automation, defect prediction, and intelligent test case generation.
  • Implement self-healing test scripts to reduce test maintenance effort.
  • Collaborate with development, DevOps, and product teams to ensure continuous testing in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Analyze large test execution data sets to identify trends, flakiness, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Integrate AI-based test data generation and predictive analytics to optimize coverage.
  • Ensure high standards of quality for functional, regression, integration, and performance testing.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers on test automation best practices and AI-driven testing methodologies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelors/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 4–8 years of experience in Test Automation and Quality Assurance.
  • Proficiency in automation tools/frameworks: Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, RestAssured, TestNG/JUnit.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
  • Hands-on experience with AI testing tools (Testim, Applitools, Mabl, etc.)
  • Familiarity with LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) for testing purposes
  • Prompt engineering know-how
  • Experience testing AI-powered features (chatbots, NLP, recommendations)
  • Knowledge of Responsible AI principles and bias detection
  • Exposure to AI observability/MLOps platforms
  • Data quality testing for ML datasets
  • Familiarity with AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot
  • Familiarity with cloud-based testing platforms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs).
  • Strong understanding of API testing (Postman, Karate, RestAssured) and performance testing (JMeter, k6, Locust).
  • Knowledge of AI concepts such as NLP, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and generative AI for QA is a plus.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with self-healing test automation frameworks.
  • Exposure to GenAI (LLMs) for test case generation and automation.
  • Knowledge of microservices testing and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience in shift-left testing and TestOps practices.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to adapt to rapidly changing technologies and environments.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI-driven QA technologies.
  • Collaborative, innovative, and inclusive work culture.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Career growth with exposure to AI and next-gen automation practices.

What you will do

We are seeking a highly qualified and motivated Senior Data Scientist with a strong background in computational biology to join the Bioinformatics Technologies team within Amgens Automation, Research Data Systems, Informatics, and AI (ARIA) organization. ARIA is a multidisciplinary group embedded within Amgens discovery engine, leveraging advancements in digital technologies for disease modeling and digital modality engineering to accelerate the pipeline from target inception through drug development. Within ARIA, Bioinformatics Technologies serves as an innovation hub for developing, deploying, and applying emerging digital technologies in computational biology to drive the next generation of therapeutic discovery.

Perturbation screening is an essential approach for understanding how genetic and non-genetic changes impact cellular systems. By systematically probing gene function and network dependencies, these studies reveal disease mechanisms, identify novel therapeutic targets, and uncover biomarkers that can guide preclinical and translational research. This capability enables more confident target validation and accelerates the path from discovery to therapeutic hypothesis generation.In this role, you will develop and apply advanced computational and AI/ML methods to analyze perturbation screening data, strengthen data interpretability, and collaborate with experimental teams to ensure computational predictions translate into actionable insights for target and therapeutic discovery. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical aptitude, have a high degree of technical competency in computational sciences with a deep theoretical understanding of AI/ML and causal learning paired with an excellent understanding of molecular biology proven by a track record of innovative and collaborative research.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and apply advanced methodologies at the intersection of functional genomics and AI/ML analytics to identify and validate novel therapeutic targets, elucidate mechanisms of action, and discover preclinical biomarkers.
  • Provide computational and data science support for high-throughput single-cell perturbation and phenotypic screening experiments (e.g., Perturb-seq) to map genephenotype relationships, uncover disease drivers, and prioritize hits for validation.
  • Drive digital innovation by identifying gaps in analytical workflows and developing robust, reproducible, and FAIR solutions that improve data interpretability, strengthen readout confidence, and accelerate therapeutic hypothesis generation.
  • Build and apply machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI approaches to simulate cellular responses to single or combinatorial genetic and non-genetic perturbations, delivering fit-for-purpose predictions that reduce experimental burden and accelerate therapeutic hypothesis generation.
  • Collaborate closely with experimental biologists and translational teams to ensure computational predictions align with experimental design and biological context, enabling testable target and biomarker hypotheses; contribute to the design of perturbation experiments so that computational and experimental approaches inform and strengthen each other.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a senior data scientist with these qualifications.

  • Any degree and 8-13 years of directly related experience

  • Strong background in machine learning and AI, including deep learning, generative modeling, and transformer-based architectures; experience with pre-training, fine-tuning, and few-/zero-shot learning, ideally with experience in in silico modeling of cellular responses to drug or genetic perturbations.
  • Proven track record of applying computational methods to drive biological insights, target validation, biomarker discovery, or therapeutic hypothesis generation.
  • Proficiency in scientific programming languages and tool development using Python, R, or similar, with familiarity in relevant libraries and frameworks.
  • Experience with large-scale data processing using cloud computing, workflow development, and software best practices (e.g., version control, continuous integration, test-driven development).
  • Familiarity with agentic AI, digital innovation approaches, and FAIR data principles for building robust and scalable analytical workflows.
  • Familiarity with molecular and disease biology, with the ability to contextualize computational findings in therapeutic discovery.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to extract and clearly present insights from complex data to diverse audiences with rigor and accuracy.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills with demonstrated ability to thrive in cross-functional teams and effectively present results to diverse audiences.
  • Creative, open-minded, and passionate about research, with a proven record of innovative algorithm and model development demonstrated through impactful publications, patents, or widely adopted tools.

Supervisor - ERP Quality Engineering (Manual & Automated Testing)


Position Summary

The Supervisor will be responsible for planning, designing, executing, and automating testing activities for large-scale ERP and digital transformation programs. The role requires a strong blend of functional ERP testing expertise, test management, and automation capabilities to ensure high-quality software delivery across complex enterprise environments.


Key Responsibilities


Functional & Manual Testing

  • Perform end-to-end testing for ERP implementations and transformation programs involving Microsoft Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, and related enterprise platforms.
  • Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and process flows to design comprehensive test plans and test scenarios.
  • Create detailed test cases, test scripts, test data, and traceability matrices from high-level requirements.
  • Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and user acceptance testing activities.
  • Validate complex business processes including:
    1. Order to Cash (O2C)
    2. Procure to Pay (P2P)
    3. Record to Report (R2R)
    4. Lead to Cash (L2C)
    5. Supply Chain and Warehouse Operations
  • Identify, document, and track defects through resolution using established defect management processes.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and development teams to ensure solution quality.


Test Automation

  • Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites using both codeless and code-based automation frameworks.
  • Build automation solutions using tools such as:
    1. Leapwork
    2. Playwright
  • Enhance and optimize automation frameworks to improve coverage, maintainability, and execution efficiency.
  • Analyze automation execution results and provide recommendations for quality improvements.
  • Support regression testing strategies through automation-first approaches.
  • Utilize AI to help develop automated test suites.


Test Management & Quality Engineering

  • Utilize test management tools including:
    1. Azure DevOps
    2. Jira
  • Create and manage test plans, test suites, test cycles, and defect workflows.
  • Prepare testing metrics, status reports, defect trends, and quality dashboards.
  • Participate in test estimation, planning, and risk assessment activities.
  • Support test environment management and release validation activities.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing practices.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and Testing.
  • Strong experience in both manual testing and automation testing.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP platforms such as Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or Salesforce.
  • Experience creating detailed test scenarios and scripts from business requirements.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools.
  • Understanding of SDLC, Agile, and DevOps.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ERP business process testing (O2C, P2P, R2R, L2C).
  • Experience with API testing and integration testing.
  • Exposure to performance testing concepts and tools.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted testing tools and techniques to improve test design, test data generation, test automation development, defect analysis, and overall testing efficiency.
  • Familiarity with generative AI platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar tools for accelerating test case creation, automation script development, and quality engineering activities.
  • Exposure to testing AI-enabled applications and generative AI solutions, including validation of AI outputs for accuracy, consistency, reliability, security, and responsible AI principles. Familiarity with common AI quality risks such as hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, non-deterministic responses, bias, data grounding issues, explainability, and model drift is preferred.

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture


Do you believe software engineering is entering a new AI-native eraAre you a problem solver who enjoys helping CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and engineering leaders rethink how software is imagined, designed, built, tested, secured and delivered using AIAre you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture


If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy Transformation practice and work with global clients to shape the next frontier of enterprise software delivery using AI. Working with C-suite stakeholders, you will help enterprises adopt AI-native software delivery at scale and turn transformation ambition into measurable outcomes. You will help enterprises define AI-powered software delivery transformation strategies and translate them into executable approaches, define target state SDLC, create platform and tooling strategy and architecture, engineering productivity measures, delivery operating model change and measurable value realization.


The Practice A Brief Sketch


Technology Strategy Transformation Practice is a part of Accenture Strategy and focuses on our clientsmost strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through engineering transformation initiatives, aimed at making software delivery powered by AI to bring productivity and quality uplift, resulting in larger enterprise value delivery.


We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, Software Engineering Transformation and AI-led Reinvention, where you will work with key global clients to shape the next evolution of enterprise software delivery. As part of this high-performing team, you will help organizations move from experimentation with AI coding tools to enterprise-wide AI Native SDLC transformation. These are some of the initiatives you will support:


AI Native SDLC Strategy and Roadmap: Assess current SDLC maturity, AI readiness, engineering productivity, application landscape assessment for AI driven delivery, toolchain landscape and delivery bottlenecks; define target-state AI Native SDLC vision and pragmatic adoption roadmap Engineering Productivity and AI Readiness Diagnosis: Diagnose developer experience, flow of work, quality gates, release throughput, automation levels, technology debt, test coverage, knowledge fragmentation and value leakage across large engineering organizations Use Case Identification and Prioritization: Identify and prioritize AI and agentic use cases across requirements, backlog, architecture, design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review, security, release, documentation and run/operate interfaces; segment applications and teams where adoption makes business and technology sense AI Native SDLC Platform and Tooling Strategy Architecture: Define architecture principles, reference architecture and tooling strategy across IDEs, repositories, CI/CD, DevSecOps, testing, knowledge systems, model gateways, context layer, RAG, agent orchestration, MCP, observability and governance Value Case and Benefits Framework: Define productivity, velocity, quality, cost, risk and developer experience outcomes; establish measurement model, value case, benefits tracking and AI cost governance Delivery Operating Model and Change: Design target-state engineering operating model considering AI native software delivery and help organization transition to new operating model Executive Advisory and Scale Strategy: Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps, investment choices, vendor strategy and scale-up plan for enterprise-wide AI Native SDLC adoption


Role Overview


We are looking for a visionary leader in Technology Strategy and Software Engineering Transformation who can help enterprises redefine how software is delivered in an AI-native world. The role requires a senior consulting practitioner with strong understanding of enterprise SDLC, AI/ GenAI and Agentic architecture, engineering productivity, Agile, CI/CD and DevSecOps.


The successful candidate will lead strategic advisory work across the AI Native SDLC transformation journey from current-state maturity and AI readiness assessment to target-state SDLC design, AI use case prioritization, platform and tooling strategy, value case development, benefits framework, roadmap definition and operating model change.


The role requires executive presence, strong consulting capability and the ability to independently engage CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs, engineering leaders and product/platform teams. The candidate should be able to shape compelling transformation narratives, facilitate senior stakeholder alignment and translate AI-powered software delivery ambition into practical, business-aligned decisions and measurable outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


AI Native SDLC Strategy and Advisory



  • Lead current-state SDLC maturity, AI readiness and engineering productivity assessments across large engineering organizations

  • Define target-state AI Native SDLC ambition and strategy across all stages of fotware delivery and software maintenance

  • Conduct application landscape assessment to Identify applications, products and teams best suited for AI-native and agentic SDLC adoption based on value, feasibility, risk and readiness

  • Identify, structure and prioritize AI and agentic use cases across the software delivery lifecycle, linking them to engineering productivity, quality and measurable outcomes

  • Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment on the adoption priorities, transformation choices and approach


Target-State SDLC Design, Architecture and Tooling Strategy



  • Design AI-Native delivery workflows and agentic patterns across all stages of SDLC

  • Define AI Native SDLC platform reference architecture across ALM, IDEs, repositories, CI/CD, DevSecOps, testing, observability, knowledge systems, model gateways, RAG/context layer, MCP/tool interfaces and guardrails with responsible AI frameworks pre-built in the design

  • Advise clients on AI platform, toolchain and vendor strategy, including integration approach, security, data/IP considerations, cost and developer adoption

  • Define architecture principles, reusable patterns, guardrails, governance constructs and agentic evaluation criteria required to scale AI-Native engineering responsibly

  • Work with architecture, platform, security and engineering teams to connect strategy with implementation realities while maintaining an advisory and transformation-planning focus


Value Realization, Productivity Measurement and Engineering Operating Model



  • Build AI Native SDLC value cases covering various dimensions across productivity, quality, risk, experience and cost

  • Define benefits framework and productivity measurement approach using baselines, KPIs, telemetry, DORA, SPACE, flow metrics, adoption metrics and executive reporting

  • Define AI value economics and cost governance across licensing, token consumption, model usage, chargeback/showback, cost guardrails and benefit realization

  • Design target engineering operating model covering product/platform ownership, AI SDLC center of excellence, roles and responsibilities, governance forums, enablement and change adoption

  • Translate target-state architecture and operating model into a phased transformation roadmap covering quick wins, foundational enablers, pilots, scaling waves and governance milestones


Executive Advisory and Market Development



  • Lead CxO-level conversations on AI Native SDLC strategy, engineering productivity, platform choices, tooling strategy, value realization, governance and operating model change

  • Create expert content, PoVs and use executive storytelling, presentation and communication skills for C-level discussions

  • Support strategic pursuits, client account development and growth initiatives through differentiated advisory propositions, points of view, solution narratives and proposal leadership.

  • Collaborate across different capabilities and teams to shape holistic client solutions and connect AI Native SDLC transformation with broader enterprise reinvention priorities

  • Develop thought leadership, market perspectives, offering assets and reusable modernization frameworks

  • Lead and mentor teams on AI, modern engineering, software delivery and engineering productivity measures


Core Skillsets Tools


Enterprise Software Engineering and SDLC



  • Strong understanding of enterprise software delivery, including Agile, DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD, test automation, secure SDLC, release management, platform engineering and SRE concepts.

  • Ability to assess SDLC maturity, engineering practices, delivery bottlenecks, toolchains, governance and productivity across large, distributed engineering organizations.

  • Strong understanding of engineering productivity, developer experience, software quality, technical debt, application complexity and delivery value streams.

  • Ability to design future-state SDLC processes, governance models and transformation roadmaps aligned to business and engineering outcomes.

  • Application Architecture, Engineering and AI


AI / Agentic Fluency, Tools and Platform Capabilities



  • Strong understanding of GenAI, LLMs and agentic software engineering concepts, including prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, MCP, agent orchestration, MCP, guardrails and evaluations

  • Practical understanding of AI-assisted SDLC use cases across requirements, backlog, architecture, coding, code review, refactoring, testing, security, documentation, release support and operations handover

  • Familiarity with leading AI coding and SDLC tools such as GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitLab Duo, Amazon Q Developer, Gemini Code Assist, Sourcegraph Cody, Atlassian Rovo or equivalent tools

  • Familiarity with AI platforms and agentic orchestration tools such as Microsoft/Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen/CrewAI, LangSmith/MLflow or equivalent platforms.

  • Understanding of enterprise context and knowledge architectures using code indexing, embeddings, vector databases, enterprise search, knowledge graphs, RAG and model ecosystems including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Llama and open-source models.

  • Ability to define toolchain architecture, vendor evaluation criteria, integration patterns, pilot approach, rollout considerations and governance required for scalable AI Native SDLC adoption.


Value, Economics and Productivity Measurement



  • Ability to formulate AI Native SDLC value cases across productivity, cycle time, quality, risk, cost, developer experience and business agility outcomes

  • Strong understanding of productivity measurement approaches including DORA, SPACE, flow metrics, adoption telemetry, developer surveys, quality metrics and release metrics

  • Ability to assess AI economics, including license cost, token consumption, model usage, cost-to-serve, utilization, chargeback/showback and benefit realization governance

  • Ability to connect AI adoption choices to measurable business outcomes and executive-level investment decisions


Consulting and Communication Skills



  • Strong consulting toolkit across structured problem solving, hypothesis-led analysis, benchmarking, assessment design, facilitation, executive storytelling, business case development and roadmap definition

  • Ability to drive CxO-level conversations with credibility, influence senior stakeholders and align business, engineering, architecture, security, finance and technology teams

  • Ability to independently lead client discussions, develop thought leadership, create compelling transformation narratives and shape opportunities in ambiguous environments

  • Experience leading proposals, strategic pursuits, senior client relationships and high-performing consulting teams


Qualification


Your experience counts!



  • Bachelors degree required; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus

  • 10+ years of experience in consulting, technology strategy, software engineering transformation, engineering productivity and AI/GenAI advisory in software delivery

  • Strong experience working with large enterprise software engineering organizations and advising senior technology leaders on SDLC transformation, engineering productivity, platform strategy and operating model change.

  • Experience leading current-state assessments, target-state designs, use case prioritization, value cases, benefits frameworks, transformation roadmaps and operating model design.

  • Practical understanding of AI/GenAI/agentic AI concepts and the emerging AI Native SDLC tool ecosystem; ability to engage with architects and engineering leaders with technical credibility

  • Experience across the following areas: Technology Strategy, Engineering Productivity, DevOps/DevSecOps, AI-assisted Software engineering

  • 4+ years of experience leading or managing large teams, including structuring analytical work, facilitating workshops and developing engineering transformation recommendations

  • Strong facilitation capability with experience in leadership workshops, design thinking sessions, value stream mapping, architecture discussions, engineering operating model design and transformation governance forums

  • Prior experience in consulting, technology strategy or client-facing advisory roles is strongly preferred

jobDescription:

This role is instrumental in architecting, deploying, and optimizing private cloud environments that leverage company's co-developed solutions with NVIDIA, as well as validated HPE reference architectures, to support enterprise-grade AI workloads at scale.

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical expertise inAI infrastructure,container orchestration platforms, andhybrid cloud environments, and will play a key role in deliveringscalable, secure, and high-performance AI platform solutionspowered byCompany'sGreenLakeandNVIDIA AI Enterprisetechnologies.



Key Responsibilities:

Leadership and Strategy:

Provide delivery assurance and serve as the lead design authority to ensure seamless execution of Enterprise grade container platform including Red Hat OpenShift and SUSE Rancher, Private Cloud AI and HPC/AI solutions, fully aligned with customer AI/ML strategies and business objectives.

Align solution architecture with NVIDIA Enterprise AI Factory design principles, including modular scalability, GPU optimization, and hybrid cloud orchestration.

Oversee planning, risk management, and stakeholder alignment throughout the project lifecycle to ensure successful outcomes.

Solution Planning and Design:

Architect and optimize end-to-end solutions across container orchestration and HPC workload management domains, leveraging platforms such as Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher, and/or workload schedulers like Slurm and Altair PBS Pro.

Ensure seamless integration of container and AI platforms with the broader software ecosystem, including NVIDIA AI Enterprise, as well as open-source DevOps, AI/ML tools, and frameworks.

Opportunity assessment:

Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs, and customer inquiries, ensuring alignment with business and technical requirements.

Conduct proof-of-concept (PoC) engagements to validate solution feasibility, performance, and integration within customer environments.

Assess customer infrastructure and workloads to recommend optimal configurations using validated reference architectures from HPE and strategic partners such as Red Hat, NVIDIA, SUSE, along with components from the open-source ecosystem.

Innovation and Research:

Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices across HPC, Kubernetes, container platforms, hybrid cloud, and security to inform solution design and innovation.

Customer-centric mindset:

Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, ensuring alignment of AI solutions with business goals.

Translate complex technical concepts into value propositions for stakeholders

Team Collaboration:

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including subject matter experts in infrastructure componentssuch asservers, storage, networkingand data science teams to ensure cohesive and integrated solution delivery.

Mentor technical consultants and contribute to internal knowledge sharing through tech talks and innovation forums.

Required Skills:

1. HPC & AI Infrastructure

Extensive knowledge of HPC technologiesand workload scheduler such as Slurmand/orAltair PBS Pro,

Proficient in HPC cluster management tools, includingCluster Management (HPCM) and/or NVIDIA Base Command Manager.

Experience with HPC cluster managers likeCluster Management (HPCM) and/or NVIDIA Base Command Manager.

Good understanding with high-speed networking stacks (InfiniBand, Mellanox) and performance tuning of HPC components.

Solid grasp of high-speed networking technologies, such asInfiniBandandEthernet.

2. Containerization & Orchestration

Extensive hands-on experience with containerization technologies such as Docker, Podman, and Singularity

Proficiency with at least two container orchestration platforms: CNCF Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, SUSE Rancher (RKE/K3S), Canonical Charmed Kubernetes.

Strong understanding of GPU technologies, including the NVIDIA GPU Operator for Kubernetes-based environments and DCGM (Data Center GPU Manager) for GPU health and performance monitoring.

3.Operating Systems & Virtualization

Extensive experience in Linux system administration, including package management, boot process troubleshooting, performance tuning, and network configuration.

Proficient with multiple Linux distributions, with hands-on expertise in at least two of the following: RHEL, SLES, and Ubuntu.

Experience with virtualization technologies, including KVM and OpenShift Virtualization, for deploying and managing virtualized workloads in hybrid cloud environments.

4. Cloud, DevOps & MLOps

Solid understanding of hybrid cloud architectures and experience working with major cloud platforms in conjunction with on-premises infrastructure.

Familiarity with DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (IaC), and microservices-based application delivery.

Experience integrating and operationalizing open-source AI/ML tools and frameworks, supporting the full model lifecycle from development to deployment.

Good understanding of cloud-native security, observability, and compliance frameworks, ensuring secure and reliable AI/ML operations at scale.

5. Networking & Protocols

Strong understanding of core networking principles, including DNS, TCP/IP, routing, and load balancing, essential for designing resilient and scalable infrastructure.

Working knowledge of key network protocols, such as S3, NFS, and SMB/CIFS, for data access, transfer, and integration across hybrid environments.

6. Programming & Automation

Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python and Bash.

Experience automating infrastructure and AI workflows.



7. Soft Skills & Leadership

Excellent problem-solving, analytical thinking, and communication skills for engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Proven ability to lead complex technical projects from requirements gathering through architecture, design, and delivery.

Strong business acumen with the ability to align technical solutions with client challenges and objectives.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors/masters degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Professional certifications in AI Infrastructure, Containers and Kubernetes are highly desirable such as RHCSA, RHCE, CNCF certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS), NVIDIA-Certified Associate - AI Infrastructure and Operations
  • Typically, 8-10 years of hands-on experience in architecting and implementing HPC, AI/ML, and container platform solutions within hybrid or private cloud environments, with a strong focus on scalability, performance, and enterprise integration.

Overview
We are seeking a Deputy Director Service Modernization AI-led Engineering to lead the global service management product and engineering transformation of PepsiCos IT ecosystem, driving an AI-first, data-driven, engineering-led, and experience-focused operating model across a large, multi-disciplinary organization.
This role owns the IT Service Management product and operating model spanning Process, Service Experience, Automation, AI-led Engineering, Reliability, and Continuous Improvement and leads service modernization initiatives that simplify ways of working, enable product-led capabilities, automate operations, and embed intelligent, self-healing patterns into the enterprise IT ecosystem.
You will manage managers, senior engineering leads, and strategic vendors across a global organization, drive modernization and engineering portfolios, and represent Service Management product capability to PepsiCo leadership
Responsibilities
  • Own and evolve the IT Service Management product and operating model, integrating Process Management, Service Experience, Automation, AI-led Engineering, Reliability Engineering, and Continuous Improvement frameworks across global operations.
  • Lead globally distributed teams, managing managers, senior engineering leads, product capability teams, automation teams, and vendors across service management, AI-led engineering, and enterprise service modernization.
  • Drive teams in an agile, product-oriented, and outcome-focused way of working, ensuring clear priorities, measurable business outcomes, disciplined execution, and continuous delivery of value.
  • Establish and govern CSL/SLA KPI structures performance dashboards, benchmarking, SLA/XLA tracking, engineering productivity metrics, service reliability metrics, and KPI Tree frameworks that connect operational performance to business value drivers.
  • Drive service modernization by partnering with platform and technology teams to harmonize fragmented service management capabilities, improve integration maturity, simplify workflows, and enable scalable, API-first and event-driven service experiences.
  • Build and scale ITSM product capabilities, workflow automation, service orchestration, and integration-led services as part of an AI-first operating model, including AIOps, conversational AI, chat/voice automation, Agentic AI, and intelligent workflow engineering to drive ticket deflection, ticket elimination, faster resolution, and productivity gains.
  • Lead engineering-led service reliability improvements by embedding automation, observability, telemetry, root cause intelligence, proactive detection, and self-healing patterns into the service management ecosystem.
  • Drive product and engineering practices across ITSM capabilities, including reusable integrations, automation frameworks, workflow standards, agile backlog management, release governance, prioritization, sprint planning, and scalable capability delivery.
  • Lead multi-vendor governance, including OrchestratorOperator models, across global functions, ensuring engineering accountability, delivery quality, cost-efficiency, standardization, and centralization opportunities.
  • Drive cost-of-service optimization through automation, digitalization, product simplification, productivity engineering, and operating model simplification.
  • Champion organizational change management, engineering capability building, AI adoption, agile maturity, and a performance-oriented, customer-led culture across global teams.
Qualifications
  • 16+ years of progressive IT/technology leadership experience, including direct experience leading large team, globally distributed organizations and managing managers/senior leads.
  • Proven track record of enterprise ITSM/Service Management transformation in regulated, large-scale environments (FMGC or comparable enterprise settings).
  • Deep expertise in ServiceNow strategy, ITIL processes, and multi-tool platform harmonization/consolidation.
  • Demonstrated success building AIOps, ServiceNow integration and automation of services, and conversational AI/chatbot capabilities that measurably reduce MTTR, ticket volume, and manual effort.
  • Strong governance experience: KPI/SLA/XLA frameworks, vendor governance, service catalogue management, and audit/compliance readiness.
  • Experience owning multi-million-dollar budgets and driving cost-of-service optimization at enterprise scale.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior leadership, Global Process Owners, and multi-vendor ecosystems.
  • Bachelor''s degree in Engineering or related field; advanced management education (MBA) preferred.

descriptionFromApi:
About EveryWatch

EveryWatch is the largest and most trusted data source in the secondary watch market. Established by a group of watch lovers, EveryWatch was created in response to the increasing popularity of luxury timepieces, with the aim of bringing unprecedented transparency and insight to the watch market. The first platform of its kind, EveryWatch combines all aspects of the watch world under one roof: a one-stop shop for watch collectors, vendors, and enthusiasts.

Position Overview

Were looking for Senior AI Engineer, Agents - an Agent Architect who will be responsible for designing, building, and scaling AI-powered solutions across EveryWatch. Working closely with our engineering, product, sales, and data teams, they will identify opportunities where AI and LLMs can automate complex processes, improve decision-making, and create new capabilities for our users and internal teams.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who combines strong Python and LLM engineering skills with a creative, proactive mindset. You will not simply be given a roadmap. You will be expected to understand how the business operates, identify where AI can make a meaningful difference, propose new solutions, and take them from idea to production.

Our existing AI work, including WatchChat, provides a foundation to build on. The opportunity now is to expand that foundation into a broader ecosystem of intelligent agents that can work with EveryWatchs unique watch-market data and support collectors, dealers, sales teams, data operations, and engineering.

In short, were looking for someone who doesnt just ask, What can we build but What should we build

What youll actually do
  • Invent the agent roadmap. Sit with sales, data and product, find the repetitive expert work, and come back with a ranked list of agents worth building - with a real view on feasibility, cost and impact. This is the core of the job, and it doesnt stop after the first quarter.
  • Build them yourself. You are hands-on. You design the architecture and you write the code - tools, loops, sub-agents, memory, state, evaluation. Not a spec-writer with a team underneath.
  • Own the platform under the agents. Every new agent should be cheaper to build than the last: shared tool layer over EverWatch data (pricing, auctions, listings, references, portfolios), an MCP surface over our existing backend, shared memory, tracing, and a reusable eval harness.
  • Harden WatchChat alongside us. Multi-turn state and memory, latency, cost, tool-call reliability, regression gates. Its live-bound and it has to stay right.
  • Make quality measurable. Golden multi-turn datasets, programmatic verifiers for tool/argument correctness, LLM-as-judge on held-out sets. If we cant measure an agent, we dont ship it.
  • Treat cost and latency as design constraints. Cheap models for routing and intent, strong models where they earn their keep; context budgets, caching, and - where it pays off - fine-tuning (SFT/LoRA on curated production trajectories) instead of ever-larger prompts.
What were looking for

Three things, and we wont trade any of them away:

  1. Creative. You generate agent ideas the business hadnt thought of, and you can tell the difference between one that will work and one that demos well. You start from a use case, not a framework.
  2. Strong architect. You can design an agent platform thats still standing in five years - state, memory, tool boundaries, sub-agent decomposition, evaluation, failure modes, cost. Youll be asked to critique our current architecture in the interview, and we expect you to find things.
  3. Heavily hands-on. You ship. Deep production experience, writing the code yourself, at pace.
Must have
  • 6+ years shipping production software, of which 2+ on LLM systems that real users touched.
  • Real agentic depth: ReAct or equivalent loops, tool/function calling, planners, state checkpointing, long-term memory, HITL steps, streaming. Not "I called the OpenAI API."
  • Hands-on LangGraph (or a strong argument for something better) plus a tracing/observability stack - LangSmith, Langfuse or similar.
  • Python in production: FastAPI, async job processing, clean service boundaries.
  • RAG done properly: retrieval + re-ranking + relevance judgement, and honest evaluation of all three.
  • Evaluation as a habit, not an afterthought (RAGAS/DeepEval/GEVAL, LLM-as-judge, pass@k).
  • Cloud production experience - AWS (Bedrock, SQS, EC2/EKS, S3) or equivalent - with Docker and CI/CD.
  • The spine pushes back on us. We explicitly want someone who asks "why did you build it like that"
Nice to have
  • LLM post-training: SFT with LoRA/QLoRA, preference/RL methods, reward and verifier design.
  • Voice agents (LiveKit/Pipecat or similar), or vision-language work.
  • Multi-agent orchestration and MCP integrations.
  • Text-to-SQL over a real, messy production schema.
  • Report/document generation agents - structured, sourced, client-ready output.
  • Guardrails, PII handling, hallucination detection, risk scoring.
  • Interest in watches, collectibles or market data. Not required - curiosity about the domain is.
What you get
  • Ownership of EverWatchs entire agent layer, and the roadmap for it - not a corner of someone elses.
  • A dataset that doesnt exist anywhere else, and users who care whether the answer is right.
  • Direct line to the CTO; decisions in days, not quarters.
  • Budget for models, tooling, and the coding agents you want to work with.
  • Competitive compensation, remote-first.

Title: Program Manager - Weather Initiatives

Job Summary
Precision Development (PxD) is seeking a strategic, impact-oriented Program Manager (PM) to lead high-profile initiatives delivering weather forecasts to smallholder farmers at scale. In this role, you will initially oversee PxD s work in India to institutionalize weather forecast dissemination to smallholders. Based in Bihar, you will work closely with government stakeholders at the state level, operating at the intersection of policy, climate adaptation, and data-driven service delivery.
This is a mission-critical management position for someone with experience in strategy execution and public sector partnerships in complex environments. You will guide and coordinate efforts from a multidisciplinary team - including product/technology, agronomy, research, and communications - through co-designing, implementation, and scaling of farmer-centric digital weather advisory services. You will serve as PxD s representative with government counterparts and key partners, ensuring that our interventions are timely, relevant, evidence-based, and deliver meaningful impact for millions of farmers on their livelihood decisions and resilience.
This role builds on PxD s demonstrated success in pioneering digital advisory services. In 2025, PxD worked with partners to disseminate AI-generated monsoon forecasts to 39+ million farmers across 13 states. The PM will play a key role in driving this scale-up in Bihar, refining the service through adaptive learning, and working with governments to design these programs for long-term impact and sustainability.


Key Responsibilities
  • Strategic Program Management. Drive end-to-end program management - from co-designing weather forecast message content and dissemination plans with partners to delivery - ensuring alignment with PxD s mission and long-term vision, as well as partner strategic priorities. Identify and scope high-impact opportunities for weather information services in collaboration with the state government. Develop and execute strategies to embed these services into government systems for sustainable scale-up.
  • Cross-functional Team Management. Coordinate across partner organizations, including scientists (for forecast production), researchers (for ME), and programme teams (for farmer-facing messaging and outreach). Structure problem-solving efforts, set clear priorities, and synchronize workstreams to achieve program milestones.
  • Government Stakeholder Engagement. Build and maintain strong relationships with government agencies and key partners to co-own the initiative. Navigate complex bureaucratic processes (e.g. approval systems and institutional governance) with professional maturity, flexibility, and tact to drive alignment and collaboration in time-constrained and dynamic settings. Develop processes and materials to embed the program into public systems, and build local capacity for sustainable delivery at scale.
  • Evidence-Driven Decision Making. Coordinate efforts with PxD s research team to establish a robust MEL system, synthesize data, generate insights, and farmer feedback into actionable improvements for better forecast content, delivery channels, and user experience. Champion a data-driven, adaptive approach so that the program continuously learns and increases its effectiveness over time.
  • Operational Execution. Own program work plans, budgets, and resources. Monitor delivery timelines (e.g. forecast release cycles, SMS/voice campaign rollouts), troubleshoot operational challenges in a timely fashion, and ensure high-quality execution across all components. Adjust plans as needed to meet targets and maintain momentum.
  • Thought Leadership Representation. Represent PxD s weather initiatives in external forums and partnerships, including engagement with senior government leadership, donors, and the broader climate adaptation community. Contribute to PxD s global learning and influence by articulating insights from the program. Support fundraising efforts.
  • Internal Learning Knowledge Sharing. Strengthen PxD s institutional knowledge by documenting lessons learned and best practices from the forecast initiatives. Mentor junior staff and facilitate knowledge exchange across teams, supporting similar efforts across geographies at PxD. Promote learning around government partnerships, climate services, and large-scale digital interventions.


Who You Are
  • Strategic Problem-Solver: You have a track record of solving problems by turning strategy into results in ambiguous, dynamic environments. You can break down complex goals into actionable plans and are quick to adapt when circumstances change.

You are comfortable working closely with government officials, scientists, researchers, and field teams. You are able to maintain composure when navigating time-sensitive engagements or variable responsiveness from partners.
  • Data-Driven Farmer-Centred: You embrace using data and evidence to drive decisions, but you also remain grounded in the realities of end-users - in this case, millions of smallholder farmers - designing solutions that are relevant and user-friendly.
  • Technically Curious Impact-Driven: You are excited about the potential of innovative technology (such as AI-based weather forecasting) to drive social impact. You can bridge the gap between cutting-edge tech solutions and on-the-ground implementation, ensuring new tools are applied in ways that genuinely improve lives.
  • Adaptive Leader: You are energized by the opportunity to lead meaningful work at scale. You demonstrate humility and adaptability, learning from failures and feedback. At the same time, you have the confidence and organizational skills to drive execution, inspire teams, and deliver against ambitious targets.


Qualifications
  • Atleast five years of experience in roles related to strategy, program management, and implementation, ideally for public sector program initiatives. Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in public policy, agriculture, economics, business, development studies, or a related field.
  • Experience working within or alongside government institutions to scale initiatives is highly preferred - for example, supporting a government-led service or acting as an embedded advisor.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, manage budgets, and drive execution in challenging, multi-faceted projects.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities. Comfort with data analysis and evidence interpretation to inform program decisions. Ability to use or learn relevant tools (e.g. dashboards, monitoring systems) to track performance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; fluency in Hindi is required; proficiency in other Indian languages is a plus. Ability to translate complex ideas into clear, actionable insights for different audiences - from writing briefings for senior officials to communicating advice to farmers in simple terms.

Knowledge Governance Management
  • Own the Knowledge Management strategy, roadmap, and operating model aligned with ITIL Knowledge Management practices
  • Define and enforce knowledge governance policies, standards, and content guidelines
  • Establish and enforce article ownership and accountability, including defined knowledge owners and contributors
  • Define knowledge base structure, taxonomy, and access controls within ServiceNow
  • Act as the Knowledge Management product owner, balancing platform capabilities and business needs
  • Own the day-to-day operation of the ServiceNow Knowledge module, including publishing workflows, approvals, and content governance enforcement
Knowledge Lifecycle Management
  • Own the end-to-end knowledge lifecycle, including creation, review, approval, publication, maintenance, and retirement
  • Enforce adherence to lifecycle processes across all teams, including mandatory reviews, approvals, and retirement of outdated content
  • Ensure outdated, duplicate, or unused content is identified and addressed
  • Establish workflows to support consistent content lifecycle execution across all teams
Content Standards Quality Management
  • Define and enforce content standards for structure, format, and readability
  • Ensure all articles are actionable, task-oriented, and audience-appropriate (end users vs. IT staff)
  • Establish and maintain a single source of truth by eliminating duplicate or conflicting content
  • Ensure knowledge is structured to support search effectiveness and AI/Copilot consumption
  • Drive continuous improvement of content quality based on usage and feedback
Cross-Functional Adoption Enablement
  • Drive adoption of ServiceNow Knowledge across IT and business functions (HR, Finance, Marketing, etc.)
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define knowledge use cases, ownership models, and content structures
  • Provide training, guidance, and onboarding for knowledge contributors and owners
  • Establish ServiceNow as the centralized, authoritative platform for knowledge management across the organization
  • Define and scale a federated knowledge ownership model enabling business units to create, manage, and maintain content within a governed framework
Reporting, Metrics Continuous Improvement
  • Define and deliver knowledge performance metrics, including:
  • Article usage and effectiveness
  • Search success and self-service adoption
  • Content quality and lifecycle compliance
  • Provide reporting and insights to leadership on knowledge health and adoption
  • Drive knowledge base cleanup initiatives, including duplicate removal, content improvement, and ownership alignment
  • Continuously improve processes based on data, trends, and stakeholder feedback
  • Track and report on article ownership, coverage, and contribution activity across teams
Service Integration Platform Ownership
  • Drive integration of knowledge into Incident, Request, and Problem Management processes to improve resolution efficiency and consistency
  • Ensure alignment with Problem Management, including creation and maintenance of Known Error and workaround articles
  • Partner with Service Desk to improve knowledge usage during ticket resolution
  • Collaborate with ServiceNow platform teams on enhancements, workflows, and automation
  • Support integration of knowledge with Copilot and AI-driven service experiences
Leadership Stakeholder Engagement
  • Act as the primary Knowledge Management subject matter expert
  • Facilitate cross-functional working sessions to define standards, ownership, and expectations
  • Provide regular updates to leadership on knowledge performance and adoption
  • Establish and maintain a sustainable Knowledge Management operating model

Education and Experience:
  • Bachelor s degree in computer science or IT or degree in a relevant field.
  • 10+ years of experience in IT Service Management or Knowledge Management
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Knowledge Management or similar platforms
  • Experience defining and implementing governance frameworks and content standards
  • Experience driving cross-functional adoption and change management initiatives
Technical Skills
Strong understanding of:
  • Knowledge lifecycle management
  • Content governance and quality standards
  • Search optimization and usability best practices
Familiarity with:
  • ServiceNow ITSM processes (Incident, Change, Problem)
  • Knowledge-centered service (KCS) or similar methodologies
  • Reporting and analytics tools
Certifications (Preferred)
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator
  • ITIL 4 Foundation or higher
  • Knowledge Management or KCS certification (preferred)

Location and Work Set-up
  • Pune, Maharashtra, India
  • Work Mode: In Office

Job Summary

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, youll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to team: Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travellers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.

The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.

We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop one software engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating robust, scalable, and secure Data Quality Platform services.
  • Set technical direction for your team across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, incident management, and data health experiences.
  • Lead and collaborate on complex, cross-organizational initiatives, making thoughtful resource, delivery, product, and architectural trade-offs to maximize strategic value.
  • Partner closely with product managers, architects, program managers, data platform teams, and data domain owners to prioritize roadmaps, clarify requirements, and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Define and raise engineering standards for coding, testing, architecture, observability, security, continuous delivery, performance, and cost management.
  • Ensure reliable operation of production systems through effective on-call strategies, incident management, root-cause analysis, capacity planning, and continuous improvement of service-level indicators and objectives.
  • Safely integrate and operate machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts to practical data platform workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor s Degree or Equivalent Level; Technical Degree Preferred.
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience and 3+ years of people management experience.
  • Proven track record of end-to-end ownership for complex software or data platform systems, including system design, application programming interface design, data modelling, implementation, and ongoing operations within a defined product or domain scope.
  • Strong proficiency in core software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and building secure, reliable, and observable services.
  • Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
  • Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, make data-driven trade-offs, and align cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality software at scale.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a software engineering team within a large-scale, distributed technology environment, with accountability for team-level architecture, technical strategy, and delivery outcomes.
  • Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including service decomposition, data modelling at scale, backward-compatible application programming interfaces, and integration with batch or streaming pipelines.
  • Deep experience with production operations at scale, including site reliability engineering practices, capacity planning, performance optimization, and building systems for high availability and resilience.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive architectural modernization, platform migration, or legacy system deprecation while maintaining strong delivery and operational outcomes.
  • Experience with cloud-native data processing, workflow orchestration, data contracts, anomaly detection, machine-assisted software or data quality workflows, and observability platforms.
  • Proven ability to build an inclusive, high-performance engineering culture and develop engineers through feedback, coaching, career planning, and meaningful technical opportunities.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request.
